body:
# 🌯 Extra Foods:Shawarma 🍟

## 🍴 A flavor explosion in your game!
## This mod adds:

### 🥬 Lettuce

### 🍟 Fries

### 🌯 Shawarma

No more virtual hunger — power up with delicious food! ⚡

## 💡 Features:

🍽 Craft and eat your food

🛒 Buy and trade in-game

🥗 Combine foods for special buffs

## 🎮 How to Install:

Place the mod file in the mods folder

Launch Minecraft

Enjoy your tasty meals! 😋

## ✨ Note: Fun mod only — buffs don’t affect real-life health.
